definition: A fixed-anchor multimodal trajectory predictor that emits mode probabilities and per-mode future Gaussian states.
A receding-horizon stochastic controller that consumes multimodal target predictions and applies chance-constraint tightening.
A declared time-invariant risk/tightening policy used by the stochastic collision constraints.
An interaction-state-dependent allocation that changes per-mode target probability or tightening within a rollout.
The nominal first SMPC command before post-solver supervisor arbitration.
A rule-proposed replacement command computed whether or not behavioural authority permits application.
do_not_conflate_with: the nominal solver command or executed command

definition: The command on the factual vehicle-control path after authority arbitration.
The complete seven-channel behavioural bundle controlling reference shaping, linearisation/cost changes, bypass, post-solver replacement and recovery state.
A quantified reduction in an aligned policy contrast between two adjacent measurement layers.
do_not_conflate_with: causal supervisor masking without an identifying contrast

definition: A descriptive contraction of policy separation downstream; by itself it does not identify which component caused the contraction.
An upstream difference whose declared downstream outcome contrast is not detected at the available precision and population.
A causal supervisor effect that reduces an upstream-policy distinction, licensed only by aligned same-state mappings or a non-saturated policy-by-authority interaction.
do_not_conflate_with: similar final trajectories under shared supervision
